doc: Hand-derived from viewport_scene.tscn, viewport_scene.gd and late_drawing.tscn, not measured (README.md 'Expected'); read by lib/gate8-vp-checks.ts. viewports: the fixture's non-root viewports by name and size (pre_arm: the eleven in the scene, an embedded Window included, before K; post_arm: the two made at K+5); renders_3d: the one whose scenario holds an instance under a camera. account: each honest leg's stream.gate8.viewports (exact keys, then `min` floors) and stream.gate8.adopt_stats (null: not judged). born: all 13 created under the hooks; 13 constructor proxies bound by adjacency (the 11 scene viewports, LateVP and LateDrawViewport) and the two scene ViewportTextures (DrawRect's and late_drawing.tscn's), re-pointed to RID() on the dummy, bound by the node route. late: 11 adopted (each default proxy adopted with it), 2 created after the arm (their constructor proxies by adjacency), late_drawing.tscn's ViewportTexture by the node route. Rendered: the same counts, the ViewportTextures re-pointed to a real render-target RID (proxies_bound_rid). off and v15: nothing live, nothing counted. sabotage legs are judged against their base leg's account (born or late). equivalence: born-only empty items allowed (none) and the adoption exceptions as lib/gate8-vp-checks.ts VP_EXCEPTIONS states them. freed is not expected (the evidence is written after the scene's teardown frees every viewport; the checker bounds it and compares the final resolved table with created + adopted), nor unresolved_now (stream-end state; the final resolved state's proxy-unresolved count is judged instead). subwindow_residue: the Popup Window registers before the late arm, so the root's subwindow canvas (layer 1024) and the Window's texture-rect item on it are RS-only residue the walk cannot adopt (excused only in that shape).

exceptions: once_seq of an adopted viewport (its advance compared)
the root's subwindow canvas (layer 1024) only in born, holding only the Popup's texture-rect draw

reference.doc: VS3 vp-reference (scripts/lib/gate8-vp-checks.ts referenceProblems): each display node's screen rect, from viewport_scene.tscn's offsets and viewport_scene.gd's positions (the late views at K+5, the popup before and after its K+24 move), and how a receiver's pixels there are judged against born-rendered's Godot shots. View3D shows a viewport that renders 3D (viewport-3d: receivers draw its 2D canvases only); AccumVP clears never (viewport-accumulation: a receiver accumulates per received frame, Godot per host frame). Everything else, the root's own pixels included, is exact within one channel step (fixtures/gsw-tolerance.json P-G1 and P-G3). late (VS5, the late legs only): the embedded Popup Window registers before the API arm, so the root's subwindow canvas and the Window's texture-rect item on it are RS-only residue the walk cannot adopt (Q4; vp-equivalence excuses the same shape, SUBWINDOW_RESIDUE_LAYER): a late receiver draws the Popup's own surface but nothing shows it on the root, so on late legs the Window's own rect at each step (by_step: 120x60 at (500,270), moved to (492,282) at K+24, before step 3) is excluded, and the rest of the popup region's swept rect is judged exactly; born legs keep the popup region exact.

client_off.doc: VS4 vp-client-off (scripts/lib/gate8-vl-checks.ts): a client built with viewports off draws every viewport texture transparent, so a region a surface feeds shows what is behind it. `differs`: the reference regions whose final pixels must differ from the on leg's (the drawing surface's strokes, the container's nested surface, the opaque surface's solid fill; at least min_differing_px pixels over the reference channel allowance). `same`: the regions and the rest of the screen that no surface feeds (the AnimatedTexture is a proxy of images, not a viewport) and must be unchanged.
